phase: Phase 4 Module 2: Admin UI Workflows, Module 1 Defect Resolution & End-to-End Verification

findings.title: Account Suspension and Deactivation Metadata Incomplete Check in assertAdminSession
findings.evidence: In Module 1, assertAdminSession only checked top-level user.banned_until and user.deleted_at. In Supabase Auth, administrative suspensions and soft deletions can be stored either on the User object or inside user.app_metadata (e.g. app_metadata.banned_until, app_metadata.deleted_at).
findings.exploitability_impact: High. Suspended or deleted administrators whose flags were set via Supabase administrative claims inside app_metadata could theoretically retain access to administrative Server Actions.
findings.before_behavior: Evaluated only user.banned_until and user.deleted_at directly on the User object.
findings.after_behavior: Evaluates both user.banned_until and user.app_metadata.banned_until (rejecting any future ban timestamp), and checks both user.deleted_at and user.app_metadata.deleted_at (rejecting non-null values).
findings.remediation: Updated assertAdminSession() in src/lib/auth/session.ts to verify both object locations fail-closed. Added comprehensive unit tests in tests/admin-service.test.mjs.
test_references: tests/admin-service.test.mjs: assertAdminSession: Rejects suspended user via app_metadata.banned_until
tests/admin-service.test.mjs: assertAdminSession: Rejects deactivated user via app_metadata.deleted_at
findings.residual_risk: None. Both user metadata layers are enforced fail-closed.

findings.title: Server Action Cache Revalidation Path Incompleteness and Node Native Test Runner Import Failure
findings.evidence: Module 1 actions revalidated only /admin/papers/${paperId} and /dashboard, failing to purge stale list views at /admin/papers or sub-routes. Additionally, static top-level import of next/cache prevented actions.ts from being loaded in Node's native ESM unit test runner.
findings.exploitability_impact: Medium. Admins viewing the paper management list table could observe stale publish or verification states. Test harness inability to import actions prevented unit testing of server action error handling.
findings.before_behavior: Static import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'; limited cache paths; failed outside Next.js bundling with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
findings.after_behavior: Created safe dynamic import helper revalidateAdminPath(); added revalidations for /admin/papers, /admin/papers/${paperId}/sequence, and /admin/papers/${paperId}/attempts.
findings.remediation: Encapsulated revalidation in dynamic import helper with graceful fallback for non-Next environments. Extended path revalidations across all administrative actions.
test_references: tests/admin-workflows.test.mjs: swapQuestionSequenceAction: Returns structured validation error on bad input
tests/admin-workflows.test.mjs: publishExamPaperAction: Returns structured validation error on bad paperId
tests/admin-workflows.test.mjs: reevaluatePaperAttemptsAction: Returns structured validation error on short reason
findings.residual_risk: None. Next.js App Router properly clears cache tags on mutation, and standalone tests execute reliably.

findings.title: Premature Database Client Acquisition Preceding Schema Input Validation
findings.evidence: In initial implementation, const db = options?.prismaClient ?? (await import('../prisma.ts')).prisma was invoked before executing Zod schema validation. Malformed client requests triggered unnecessary database client resolution.
findings.exploitability_impact: Low. Unnecessary resource consumption and potential internal error bubbling on malformed requests.
findings.before_behavior: Database resolution occurred prior to Zod schema parse.
findings.after_behavior: Zod schema parsing occurs strictly first at the function boundary, failing fast with ZodError prior to any database connection acquisition.
findings.remediation: Reordered execution sequence in publishExamPaper, reevaluatePaperAttempts, and swapQuestionSequence to parse inputs immediately.
findings.residual_risk: None. Strict input validation boundary enforced.

findings.title: Protected Admin Layout Shell & Operational Overview Dashboard
findings.evidence: Implemented server-side protected admin shell with assertAdminSession() at layout level. Unauthorized or non-admin callers receive 403 Forbidden boundary. Overview dashboard provides live operational telemetry (total papers, published papers, questions, attempts, recent papers).
findings.before_behavior: Admin routes did not exist or had no unified layout.
findings.after_behavior: Server-side layout enforces strict authentication and authorization; renders responsive navigation bar and live KPI summary.
findings.remediation: Created src/app/admin/layout.tsx and src/app/admin/page.tsx with zero 'any' types.

findings.title: Exam Paper Management Table with Filter, Search & Pagination
findings.evidence: Implemented bounded paper management table supporting case-insensitive title search, publish status filtering (DRAFT, IN_REVIEW, VERIFIED, PUBLISHED, ARCHIVED), bounded pagination (default 10, max 50), and quick action links to Sequence Editor, Publication Review, and Adjudication Dashboard.
findings.after_behavior: Fully responsive, server-rendered data table with query param filtering and zero client-side data leaks.

findings.title: Question Sequence Editor with Atomic Single-Statement Reordering & Immutability Check
findings.evidence: Implemented question sequence reordering for unpublished exam papers. Enforces atomic single-statement execution via PostgreSQL CASE statement: UPDATE paper_question_occurrences SET sequence_number = CASE WHEN id = $1 THEN $seq2 WHEN id = $2 THEN $seq1 END WHERE id IN ($1, $2) AND paper_id = $paperId. Enforces published content immutability: rejects reordering if paper is PUBLISHED.
findings.exploitability_impact: Critical. Naive two-step UPDATE statements cause unique constraint violations on (paper_id, sequence_number). Modifying published papers violates auditability and exam reproducibility.
findings.before_behavior: No sequence editor; no sequence swap service.
findings.after_behavior: Atomic CASE swap executes cleanly without transient constraint collisions; published papers strictly rejected with MCQJ_IMMUTABLE_ERROR; UI provides Move Up / Move Down controls.
findings.remediation: Implemented swapQuestionSequence() service, swapQuestionSequenceAction() server action, and SequenceEditorClient component.
test_references: tests/admin-workflows.test.mjs: swapQuestionSequence: Rejects reordering questions on a PUBLISHED paper (immutability)
tests/admin-workflows.test.mjs: swapQuestionSequence: Successfully swaps sequence numbers atomically on DRAFT paper
tests/admin-workflows.test.mjs: swapQuestionSequenceAction: Returns structured validation error on bad input
findings.residual_risk: None. Atomic statement-level uniqueness guaranteed by PostgreSQL.

findings.title: Publication Review Modal with 6-Gate Verification Checklist & Double Confirmation
findings.evidence: Implemented publication pre-flight review screen evaluating 6 core criteria: (1) Paper status is VERIFIED, (2) Question count >= 1, (3) Sequence is contiguous 1..N without gaps, (4) 100% of questions are editorially verified (is_verified = true), (5) Active answer key exists, (6) Booklet series configured. Publish button is disabled until all 6 pass. Requires explicit typing of paper title in double-confirmation modal.
findings.exploitability_impact: High. Accidental publication of unverified or incomplete papers causes irreversible student-facing exam corruption.
findings.before_behavior: No visual publication review interface or pre-flight checklist.
findings.after_behavior: 6-gate checklist visually displays pass/fail criteria; confirmation modal prevents accidental submission; connects to publishExamPaperAction().
test_references: tests/admin-workflows.test.mjs: Publication Gate Logic: Identifies contiguity and gap correctly
tests/admin-workflows.test.mjs: Publication Gate Logic: Strict editorial verification check
findings.residual_risk: None. Both client-side checklist and database-side stored procedure enforce gates.

findings.title: Answer-Key Adjudication & Historical Two-Tier Ledger Re-evaluation Dashboard
findings.evidence: Implemented answer-key adjudication dashboard for published papers. Displays published status, current active key version, answer key items, and submitted attempt count. Provides form to select new answer key version and enter mandatory adjudication justification (minimum 10 characters). Double-confirmation modal explicitly warns that active evaluations will be updated while historical v1 evaluations remain permanently immutable. Displays full re-evaluation history ledger.
findings.exploitability_impact: High. Unaudited answer-key changes or silent overwrites of historical evaluations destroy transparency and legal integrity.
findings.after_behavior: Adjudication dashboard enables controlled, audited re-evaluation; enforces double-confirmation; records version increment and reason; presents immutable audit ledger.
test_references: tests/admin-workflows.test.mjs: reevaluatePaperAttemptsAction: Returns structured validation error on short reason
findings.residual_risk: None. Two-tier evaluation ledger guarantees historical evaluation immutability.
